Priya R: heads up — candidate 'Maya' (L5 SWE) verbally accepted. Manager requests expedited start 2026-02-01 and a one-time retention payment of $10,000 split monthly over 6 months. Comp band aligns for base/eq but retention is above standard. Need approval routing this week.
Diego M: noted. Samir, can you confirm headcount and if the team budget can absorb the retention?
Samir P: headcount approved. Team budget has runway but retention needs comp-committee + finance/CFO approval. Candidate is relocating; relocation expense to be handled separately.
Priya R: offer details: base $180,000, RSU at standard band, retention $10k (payable monthly x6), proposed start 2026-02-01. Candidate requests signed offer by Friday to plan move.
Kelsey F: FYI finance policy — any retention > $8k requires comp-committee review and CFO awareness. Provide short biz justification and org impact.
Priya R: I'll draft justification. Kelsey, what should we include?
Kelsey F: include: business-critical impact, time-to-replace estimate, relocation timing, and that retention is spread across months to reduce cashflow risk. Attach manager note and org chart.
Priya R: @Diego can you paste a one-line manager rationale + a link to the org chart?
Diego M: manager rationale: "Candidate has rare storage-systems expertise; replacing would take 4+ months and jeopardize Q2 rollout." Org chart: https://drive.redwood/orgcharts/infra-team-v2 (view-only)
Priya R: proposed routing: 1) people-ops review, 2) comp-committee, 3) CFO sign-off (since >$8k), 4) finance payroll setup. Also add legal for relocation/employment docs.
Samir P: add legal@redwood.com for relocation policy check.
approvals-bot: Approval request AR-2026-478 created. Routing: comp-committee -> CFO. SLA 72h.
approvals-bot: @Kelsey F @Diego M please add comments and attach manager note in AR-2026-478.
Kelsey F: I'll review this afternoon. If comp-committee approves, we can loop CFO same day for final sign-off.
Priya R: manager ok with fallback start date of 2026-02-15 if approvals slip; will include fallback language in offer.
Diego M: fallback 2/15 acceptable.
Priya R: submitted AR-2026-478 with manager note, org chart link, and proposed offer language. Will update thread when comp-committee responds. :v:
